C1236.title: Beijing News Reviews 2021 Antitrust Penalties Against Internet Platforms
C1236.summary: In December 2021, Beijing News reviewed the year's antitrust enforcement against internet platforms. Alibaba was fined 18.228 billion yuan for abusing market dominance, Meituan was fined 3.442 billion yuan for exclusive-dealing conduct, and Tencent and other platform companies also received penalties for failing to report concentrations. The report called 2021 a landmark year for antitrust enforcement in China.
